en: What were my sales this week?

steps: Ask the assistant for your orders and sales for today, yesterday, this week (from Saturday), the last 7 days or this month
It returns the number of orders, sales collected (paid orders plus delivered cash-on-delivery orders, net of refunds), refunds and the average order value, in your language, read live from the store
edgeCases: Owner only: a staff member is told the figures are the owner's
No store bound (standalone workspace): the tool is not offered and the assistant says it has no store figures
Figures can be up to a minute old (cached for 60 seconds per period); the store dashboard is the live source
Cash-on-delivery orders that are not delivered yet count as orders but not as collected sales
A period with more than 20,000 orders is refused rather than summed partly
gaps: No screen yet: the assistant reads it, or the route
